_comment: backfill=true fetches full 90-day history + derives price in one pass. Use for initial population. raw mode (backfill=false) is for ongoing delta refreshes once history is captured.
_shard_note: For overnight local runs, max ~9 subprocesses safely (23GB RAM / ~2.5GB per subprocess). Premium/base: always use --sport filter so shards apply to one sport at a time.
